vulnerability_cn: 报价时间上界缺失与受信签名路径组合
vulnerability_en: Missing upper timestamp bound combined with a trusted signer path
detail_cn: performUpkeep 检查订单年龄和报价不得早于订单，却不拒绝未来报价。代表交易批量提交同一时间戳 2000000000 的 5,000 和 60,000 报价，制造平仓收益；回执复算 oLP 净流出 1,078,403.5804 USDC、交易者净流入 1,078,319.4804 USDC。利用仍需要有效受信签名和已授权 forwarder，普通调用者不能任意伪造报价。源码已取得，但完整内部跟踪、历史权限映射及全部代理实现未独立核实；未重放。源表整体损失与描述、披露口径不一，金额留空。
detail_en: performUpkeep checks order age and rejects reports older than the order, but has no upper timestamp bound. The focal batch submitted prices 5,000 and 60,000 with timestamp 2000000000 and settled artificial profit. Receipt reconciliation gives a 1,078,403.5804 USDC net oLP outflow and 1,078,319.4804 USDC net trader inflow. Exploitation still requires a valid trusted signature and an authorized forwarder; arbitrary callers cannot forge prices. Original source was acquired, while full internal traces, historical authorization mappings and all proxy implementations remain independently unverified; no replay. The aggregate USD loss is blank because sheet descriptions and disclosures conflict.
loss_scope: Unknown aggregate USD loss: source-sheet description says USD 11.86M while lost/lost_u say USD 24M; focal-transaction amounts are not the incident total.
